'''Amina Doumane''' (2 September 1990) is a Moroccan computer scientist who on during 2017 won the French Giles-Kahn prize for the best doctoral thesis in France. Her thesis was on the subject ''On the infinitary proof theory of logics with fixed points''. On 31 January 2018 Doumane was presented with the award by the French computer science society (SIF).<ref name= 'PhD award'>{{cite web|url=http://www.ens-lyon.fr/en/article/research/amina-doumane-conferred-gilles-kahn-award-best-phd-thesis|title=Amina Doumane conferred Gilles Kahn Award for best PhD thesis|date=23 January 2018}}</ref>

==Research==
Her doctoral thesis centered around a circular proof system.<ref> {{Cite web| title = Prix de thèse Gilles Kahn et Prix La Recherche pour Amina Doumane| work = INS2I| accessdate = 2021-01-20| date = 2018-01-02|url=https://ins2i.cnrs.fr/fr/cnrsinfo/prix-de-these-gilles-kahn-et-prix-la-recherche-pour-amina-doumane}} </ref>

==Honours, decorations, awards and distinctions==
Gilles Kahn prize for best French doctoral thesis, 2017, by the ''Société informatique de France'' (SIF).<ref> {{Cite web| title = Lauréats 2017| work = La Société informatique de France| accessdate = 2021-01-20|url=https://www.societe-informatique-de-france.fr/recherche/prix-de-these-gilles-kahn/laureats-2017/}} </ref>
